typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*you were at the church, making sure everyone was doing well and had everything they needed, many wanted posters of Ruv/Ruvyzvat on the wall, everyone had no idea that wanted assassin lived with you in your house, once the day was over, you closed the church before walking home, once there it was way to quiet, you would walk into his bedroom and not see him there, before a hand wrapped around your waist and one covering your mouth, a soft Russian voice behind you*


“Mmmm… I snuck up on ya didn’t I..?”
